name: Pelso Yuzu-Bissap Blaze
description: A sharp, high-acid soda blending yuzu citrus extract with deep hibiscus-bissap concentrate, producing a vivid crimson drink with a citrus-tart punch and a dry floral tail. Halvara Corp acquired Pelso three years ago but kept the original formula intact to avoid backlash.
flavor_profile: Bright yuzu zest up front, tart hibiscus mid-palate, dry floral finish with a slight tannic edge
cultural_context: Pelso loyalists — mostly Tier 2 and lower Tier 3 — are vocal about the acquisition and suspicious that the formula has slowly drifted. Blind taste tests circulate on local mesh boards, comparing old batch cans salvaged from stockrooms against current production. The drink has become a minor symbol of corporate absorption anxiety.
story_hooks: Someone is selling pre-acquisition Pelso cans at collector prices in a Shelf market — but the cans look suspiciously new, suggesting a counterfeiting operation.
A Halvara Corp product manager needs to quietly prove the formula hasn't changed before a media exposé drops — she hires an independent flavor analyst with complicated loyalties.
A Pelso Drinks founder, now sidelined post-acquisition, is developing an unlicensed successor formula in a converted warehouse in the Tier 1 border zone.
